value.text: Resolution & evidence (2026-07-13): PROBLEM: npm run release:check failed at audit:prod with EALLOWSCRIPTS (--allow-scripts not allowed in project-scoped installs) because ~/.npmrc sets allow-scripts and the bare `npm audit --omit=dev` inherited the restricted environment. The partial migration also introduced `npx tsc` in typecheck:frontend/build:frontend, which can trigger npx network resolution even though local tsc exists. FIX (package.json only; no HTML/CSS/legal/hosted/telemetry/secrets touched): (1) audit:prod changed from `npm audit --omit=dev` to `env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts` (matches established pattern in pm-csv/pm-github/pm-linear; unsets npm_config_allow_scripts so npm does not reject the restricted environment, --ignore-scripts keeps audit non-mutating). (2) typecheck:frontend/build:frontend replaced all `npx tsc` with bare `tsc` (npm adds node_modules/.bin to PATH; local typescript@7.0.2 resolves with no npx/network fallback) and extended to compile the three frontend projects (main + tsconfig.sw.json + tsconfig.scripts.json). VERIFICATION (all green): git diff check shows only .gitignore/package.json/public/tsconfig.json changed plus pre-existing .agents/pm files preserved; untracked TS sources + tsconfigs + test. npm run typecheck PASS. npm run build PASS. npm test 74 pass 0 fail (incl 4 new static-scripts tests). Direct audit: env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts found 0 vulnerabilities exit 0. Scripted audit: npm run audit:prod found 0 vulnerabilities exit 0 (EALLOWSCRIPTS resolved). npm run pack:dry-run PASS (207 files; public/sw.js 12.4kB + public/cookie-consent.js 2.1kB packed for runtime serving). npm run changelog:check: Changelog up to date exit 0. npm run release:check (full gate) exit 0. Generated outputs public/sw.js + public/cookie-consent.js are valid plain JS (new Function parses), serve exactly at /sw.js and /cookie-consent.js, and are git-ignored (.gitignore lines 15-16); public/src/sw.ts and public/src/cookie-consent.ts are tracked (NOT ignored). Reopened-item follow-up — Greptile bb239654 P2 findings addressed minimally (2 source files only; no HTML/CSS/legal/hosted/telemetry/secrets/Greptile/unrelated files touched; not committed/pushed):

1) public/tsconfig.scripts.json (import-free directly-served cookie-consent classic script): removed the bundler-specific "moduleResolution": "bundler", letting TypeScript 7 apply its direct-script default. Verified TS 7 context: "classic", "node"/"node10" are REMOVED (TS5108); "node16"/"nodenext" require matching module values (TS5110); only "bundler" or the omitted default are valid with module:ES2022, so omitting is the correct TS-7-compatible direct-script default. Strictness NOT weakened: "strict": true preserved (tsc --showConfig confirms strict:true, moduleResolution no longer present). moduleDetection:"legacy" retained (classic-script-appropriate, not bundler-specific). cookie-consent.ts typecheck+emit green; emitted /cookie-consent.js (2130 bytes) still parses as plain JS classic IIFE.

2) test/static-scripts.test.ts buildScripts() helper: changed execFileSync stdio from ["ignore","pipe","pipe"] (captures diagnostics) to ["ignore","inherit","inherit"] — tsc stdout/stderr diagnostics now forward directly to the CI log while stdin stays ignored (noninteractive, no prompts). On tsc failure, diagnostics flow to CI instead of being trapped in the thrown error.

VERIFICATION (pm test --run --progress, all green):
- linked-test 1/3 audit:prod (env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts): passed exit 0, 0 vulnerabilities.
- linked-test 2/3 npm run release:check: passed exit 0 — typecheck + build + 74/74 tests pass 0 fail (incl 4 static-scripts tests using the modified buildScripts helper) + audit:prod 0 vuln + pack:dry-run 207 files (public/sw.js 12.4kB + public/cookie-consent.js 2.1kB packed) + changelog:check up to date.
- linked-test 3/3 npm run typecheck:frontend: passed exit 0.

git diff scope: only public/tsconfig.scripts.json (-1 line) and test/static-scripts.test.ts (+2/-1) changed.
